patch.value: Remove GitHub Actions workflows from the private pm-web repository and disable repository Actions so the private website/package repo does not use GitHub-hosted runners. Public pm packages keep their daily release jobs; pm-web is the private exception requested for the website repo.
Remove GitHub runners from private pm-web repo
Repository Actions permissions are disabled; .github/workflows CI/release files are removed; local build/test/package checks remain documented; changelog is regenerated from pm items.
Disabled GitHub Actions for unbraind/pm-web through repository permissions and removed CI/release workflow files from the private repo.
The private pm-web repository no longer schedules or triggers GitHub-hosted runner jobs.
gh API reports actions.enabled=false and workflow files are deleted on the cleanup branch.
Private pm-web GitHub runner usage removed and repository Actions disabled.
